decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted numbered P01, P02 received on 6th October 2010 and numbered P03 B and P04 B received on 29th November 2010 therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - The windows formed in the flank walls of the single storey rear extension, side dormer and replacement ground floor window on the house shall be obscure glazed, hinged to open inwards and shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than with obscured glazing.
Condition : 5 - The roof lights hereby permitted shall be flush with the existing plane of the roof.
description: Erection of side and rear roof extensions with roof lights  and a single storey rear extension to the house.
